identified_issues: The authorization middleware validates requests against role permissions without checking the target volume operational mode (PRIMARY_MODE vs STANDBY_MODE).

Rule Set v4.2 permits SYNC_FROM_SNAPSHOT on active primary volumes, directly violating the prerequisite that prevents snapshot overwrites during active transactional writes and uncommitted memory buffers.
evidence: Volume VOL_481 is documented as currently operating in PRIMARY_MODE, actively processing live customer database writes.
Operational prerequisites specify that SYNC_FROM_SNAPSHOT requires no active transactional writes or uncommitted buffers to exist, conditions that are violated in PRIMARY_MODE.
Worker worker-backup-09 requested SYNC_FROM_SNAPSHOT on VOL_481, which was authorized and scheduled solely because the action exists in the permitted_actions list of the VOLUME_OPERATOR role.
recommended_action: Immediately abort the scheduled SYNC_FROM_SNAPSHOT action on VOL_481, and update the authorization middleware and Rule Set v4.2 to enforce state-aware authorization rules that restrict SYNC_FROM_SNAPSHOT strictly to volumes in STANDBY_MODE.
